messages:
rachel: Alerting - ap-south GPU fleet reports repeated role-assume failures during node bootstrap this morning. New nodes never join, showing 403 from STS. Anyone else seeing this?

 tom: yep, noticed ~10 failed joins across 3 AZs starting ~06:10. Logs: `STS: AccessDenied: Condition failed: aws:RequestTag/region == ap-south`

 priya: that's the new conditional IAM policy we applied to tighten cross-region grants (policy landed at 06:00). It requires a request tag `region` matching the RC environment. If metadata proxy doesn't send tag, assume fails.

 rachel: minimal trace: `meta-proxy: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity -> 403 ConditionNotMet` then kubelet: `node join failed: auth error`.

 tom: why would proxy omit the tag only in ap-south? We're seeing it in other regions too but retries there masked it due to longer TTLs. ap-south backend NAT had brief saturation so some requests retried without tag header set by client lib?

 priya: suspect: older metadata client lib (v1.3.2) didn't populate the optional request tag header on fast retries. Newer versions include it. We rolled the policy without ensuring all fleets had updated client.

 rachel: impact: capacity shortfall ~14 GPUs, autoscaler is starving some batch jobs. SEV-3. Suggest two-step mitigate: 1) temp relax IAM condition for ap-south; 2) rollout client lib bump + deploy.

 tom: ops-bot create CR? Also we should scope relax to the role ARN for node bootstrap only, not broad.

 ops-bot: Created CR-2026-129: "ap-south IAM condition relax: allow missing request-tag for node-bootstrap role (temp)". Approvers: @priya, @rachel. Auto-expire: 3h. Runbook link added.

 priya: approved. I'll scope the exception to `role/node-bootstrap/*` and add audit flag to track use. Also schedule client update rollout (P0).

 sre-oncall: applying change now. Monitoring node join rate and STS error rate. If joins return to baseline, we'll close incident.

 rachel: after change, join failures dropped to 1 in 10m, GPUs returning. Good. Please ensure postmortem covers: policy rollout checklist, client-version inventory by region, and cost impact from delayed provisioning.

 priya: opening PM-2026-498. Action items: inventory clients (P0), backfill tag in metadata lib for backward compat (P1), improve policy rollout gating (P1).

 tom: cost note: delayed joins caused autoscaler to spin up on-demand fallbacks in eu-west for some jobs, added ~ $120 for the hour. Add to PM.

 rachel: thanks team. Keep an eye on other regions before we re-tighten. :eyes:
